verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents migration guides from Gmail, Spark and Superhuman, plus a dedicated 'import full history' how-to. A user reports it imported their aliases and signatures. However, the default import covers only the last 90 days, and community reports say free-plan users don't get older history imported or searchable. The product also works only on top of Gmail via Gmail APIs, not IMAP or other providers. Missing for 10: documented complete-history import across plans, any contacts import, import from non-Gmail providers, and independent confirmation of full-history import.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client
